text: We no all 'e same a' you!--Suppose one got money, all got money. You;--suppose one got money--lock him up in chest.--No good!"--"Kanaka all 'e same a' one!" This principle they carry so far, that none of them will eat anything in the sight of others without offering it all round. I have seen one of them break a biscuit, which had been given him, into five parts, at a time when I knew he was on a very short allowance, as there was but little to eat on the beach.
